summary: CR-018 Wastage Report Enhancements verified. All 3 intelligence features (Top Wasted Items, Reason Breakdown, Period Comparison) are correctly implemented with proper empty state guards. When 0 wastage records exist (German Fluid 806 hierarchy), intelligence sections are correctly hidden. Existing KPIs, filters, table, and CSV export continue to work.

features_tested.feature: CR-018 T2: Intelligence sections code review
features_tested.details: Code review confirms correct implementation: topWastedItems useMemo (lines 194-211), reasonBreakdown useMemo (lines 214-227), lossCount/gainCount (lines 230-231), prevPeriodData state + useEffect for trend fetch (lines 234-259), trendDelta useMemo (lines 261-274). All sections guarded by entries.length > 0 (line 383).

critical_code_review_comments: WastageReport.jsx line 383: Intelligence sections correctly guarded by entries.length > 0
WastageReport.jsx lines 194-211: topWastedItems aggregates by item name, sorts by totalQty, returns top 5 with percentage and bar width
WastageReport.jsx lines 214-227: reasonBreakdown aggregates by waste_reason, calculates percentage and bar width
WastageReport.jsx lines 237-259: Previous period trend fetches data for equivalent previous period (same day span)
WastageReport.jsx lines 261-274: trendDelta calculates percentage change with proper null/zero handling

All data-testids correctly implemented: period-comparison, trend-current, trend-previous, trend-delta, top-wasted-items, top-wasted-item-{rank}, reason-breakdown, reason-row-{index}, loss-gain-summary
